_meta.rule_hash_definition: sha256 of the canonical (sorted-keys, compact) JSON of registration_id, name, market, rule_text, gates and evaluation_window. The implementation files are hashed beside it so a code change is visible even if the prose is not.
_meta.teeth: luck_lab/check.py recomputes every rule_hash from the source files and fails if one differs.

what_would_change_our_mind.would_refute: Treat the signal as absent if any of these hold: the prospective lower bound on skill covers 0 at that sample size; the calibration gap keeps the same sign and exceeds 0.03 (a level shift, not a signal); the profit from the single best game exceeds 20% of the total once the sample is large enough to judge; another strategy in the family clears the bar and this one does not, at the same window.
